# Orbit Pixel Studio

> Orbit Pixel Studio is a digital solutions studio based in Ambernath, Maharashtra, India, offering website development, SEO, social media marketing, lead generation, graphic design, video editing, AI content and workflow automation, paid ads management, and website maintenance for small and growing businesses.

Orbit Pixel Studio brings strategy, creativity and technology together to help businesses build a digital presence and generate customers. Founded on the principle of Create · Innovate · Grow.

## Services

- [Website Development](https://orbitpixelstudio.in/services/website-development.html): Modern, responsive, high-converting websites — starting ₹9,999/website
- [SEO](https://orbitpixelstudio.in/services/seo.html): Keyword strategy, on-page SEO, local & Google Business Profile optimization, technical audits, monthly reporting — starting ₹6,999/month
- [Social Media Marketing](https://orbitpixelstudio.in/services/social-media-marketing.html): Content calendars, reels & posts, community engagement — starting ₹4,999/month
- [Lead Generation](https://orbitpixelstudio.in/services/lead-generation.html): Funnel design, landing pages, lead capture and follow-up automation — starting ₹7,499/month
- [Meta & Google Ads](https://orbitpixelstudio.in/services/meta-google-ads.html): Targeted ad campaign management — starting ₹4,999/month management fee (ad spend separate)
- [Graphic Design & Branding](https://orbitpixelstudio.in/services/graphic-design.html): Logo design, brand identity, social creatives, print & packaging — starting ₹499/design
- [Video Editing](https://orbitpixelstudio.in/services/video-editing.html): Reels & shorts editing, colour grading, motion graphics — starting ₹799/video
- [Video Shoot](https://orbitpixelstudio.in/services/video-shoot.html): On-location video shoots, up to 2 hours — starting ₹1,899/session
- [AI Automation & Content](https://orbitpixelstudio.in/services/ai-automation.html): AI-assisted content, automated lead capture and WhatsApp follow-up — starting ₹999/content
- [Website Maintenance](https://orbitpixelstudio.in/services/website-maintenance.html): Content updates, performance optimization, uptime & security monitoring, technical support — custom plans
